candleCareSection.title: How to love your candle
candleCareSection.tip1Body: Let it burn 2–3 hours so the wax melts fully to the edges.
candleCareSection.tip2Body: Trim to 5mm before each re-light for a clean, even flame.
candleCareSection.tip3Body: Don't burn more than 3 hours at a time.
candleCareSection.tip4Body: Let it reach room temperature before lighting again.

ourStory.title: Our story
ourStory.intro: 55candles was born from a simple idea: candles should be honest, beautiful, and safe for your home.
ourStory.edibleBody: No. But we totally understand why you'd ask. The wax fruit on every candle is hand-sculpted to look almost impossibly real. It's a compliment we hear every day.
ourStory.value1Body: Every candle uses soy wax and a cotton wick. No paraffin, no lead, no compromises.
ourStory.value2Body: We use only phthalate-free fragrance oils. Safe for you, your family, and your pets.
ourStory.value3Body: No fillers, no mystery ingredients. Every component is listed on the label.

candleCarePage.title: Candle care
candleCarePage.subtitle: Simple steps to make your 55candles last longer and burn better.
candleCarePage.firstBurnBody: Always burn your candle until the wax melts fully to the edges of the can — this usually takes 2 to 3 hours. Skipping this step can cause tunnelling, where wax builds up around the wick and reduces your candle's life.
candleCarePage.wickBody: Trim the wick to 5mm before every burn. A long wick creates a larger, sootier flame. A quick trim keeps the burn clean and even.
candleCarePage.burnTimeBody: Keep burns to 3 hours maximum. After 3 hours the can gets hot enough to affect the wax quality. Give your candle a rest — it'll reward you with a longer life.
candleCarePage.storageBody: Keep the lid on when not burning. Store away from direct sunlight and in a cool room. Wax can soften in heat, which may shift the wax fruit decoration.
